fullDescription: A high-end dark mode administrative dashboard style characterized by a luxury fintech aesthetic. It features a deep black and emerald gradient background with parallax star animations, neon green (#1A7E5C) and metallic gold (#D4AF37) accents. The design uses 'Manrope' for bold, modern headings and 'Inter' for highly legible data entry. Key UI patterns include glassmorphism, glow-border cards, and multi-step progress indicators. This style is ideal for fintech, banking, gold trading, crypto platforms, or luxury asset management systems requiring secure, professional-grade data entry environments with integrated compliance monitoring.

structured.summary: Luxury dark-themed administrative dashboard with emerald and gold accents, featuring high-contrast data entry forms, real-time status indicators, and multi-step workflow logic.

style.description: The design aesthetic combines high-tech utility with luxury finishes. Backgrounds are deep black (#0A0A0A) with subtle emerald gradients. Typography pairs Manrope (for titles and labels) with Inter (for body and data). Interactive elements utilize a neon green glow (#1A7E5C) for focus states and a metallic gold (#D4AF37) for primary call-to-actions or value displays. Animations include smooth 0.8s fade-up transitions and pulsating border glows to signify activity or validation.
style.prompt:
Create a design system using a palette of #0A0A0A (Primary Background), #1A7E5C (Neon Green Accent), and #D4AF37 (Metallic Gold Accent). 
- **Typography**: Headings and labels use 'Manrope' (Weights: 600, 700, 800), body text and data use 'Inter' (Weights: 400, 500). 
- **Glassmorphism**: Cards should have a background of `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03)`, a border of `1px solid rgba(26, 126, 92, 0.3)`, and a `backdrop-filter: blur(20px)`. 
- **Shadows/Glows**: Focused elements use `box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(26, 126, 92, 0.3)`. Text for active status uses `text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(26, 126, 92, 0.8)`. 
- **Inputs**: Form fields are dark `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03)` with `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4)` placeholder text, transitioning to a green border glow on focus. 
- **Animation**: Use a custom `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` for 0.8s fade-in-up transitions on all major UI containers.

layout_and_structure.description: A structured dashboard layout with a sticky glassmorphism header, a centralized multi-step form area (2/3 width), and a complementary status sidebar (1/3 width).

prompts.prompt: Sticky top bar with `backdrop-filter: blur(12px)`. Background: `#0A0A0A/80`. Include a logo section on the left with a 45-degree rotated square icon (#1A7E5C). Center/Right: Include a dynamic UTC timestamp and a user profile avatar with a gold-to-green diagonal gradient.

Horizontal layout above the main form. Circles (40px) with 2px borders. Active state: `#1A7E5C` background with inner glow. Completed state: Low opacity green. Connect circles with 2px lines (`#1A7E5C` when active, low opacity when inactive). Labels below steps in all-caps, extra-letter-spacing, size 10px.

A dedicated search module at the top of the form. 12px rounded corners. Includes a high-contrast input field and a solid green button. Below the input, a data-card appears showing customer stats in a 2-column grid with 'verified' status badges using green low-opacity backgrounds.

Grid-based data entry with 24px gaps. Each step contained in a glassmorphism card. Use field labels in all-caps, 0.75rem size, tracked at 0.05em. Bottom of card features action buttons: secondary buttons (transparent with border) and primary buttons (solid gold with dark text).

Vertical stack of widgets including: 1. Quick Stats (large numbers with neon glow). 2. Compliance Status (List of items with checkmark badges). 3. Activity Feed (Timeline with small icons and high-contrast labels).

special_ui_components.description: Interactive range slider for selecting quantities.
special_ui_components.prompt: A slider with a 6px height track. The active portion is neon green (#1A7E5C). The thumb is a 24px circle in metallic gold (#D4AF37) with a 2px green border and a gold outer glow. Include min/max labels below.

special_ui_components.description: Rounded pill-shaped badges for system states.
special_ui_components.prompt: Pill-shaped badge (999px radius). Valid: `rgba(26, 126, 92, 0.2)` background, `#1A7E5C` text and border. Warning/Pending: `rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.2)` background, `#f59e0b` text. Failed: `rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.2)` background, `#ef4444` text. All use uppercase 10px bold font.

special_ui_components.description: Large interactive tiles for category selection.
special_ui_components.prompt: Cards with `1px solid rgba(26, 126, 92, 0.3)`. Contains a custom radio circle and a bold label. On selection, the border intensifies to solid `#1A7E5C` and a subtle green glow appears behind the tile.
